gnaeus julius agricola: Gnaeus Julius Agricola is Roman general who was governor of Britain and extended Roman rule north to the Firth of Forth.
Gnaeus Julius Agricola means the same as Agricola.
gnaeus pompeius magnus: Gnaeus Pompeius Magnus is Roman general and statesman who quarrelled with Caesar and fled to Egypt where he was murdered.
Gnaeus Pompeius Magnus means the same as Pompey or Pompey the Great.
gnaphalium: Gnaphalium is large widely distributed genus of coarse hairy herbs with whitish involucres.
Gnaphalium means the same as genus Gnaphalium.
gnaphalium sylvaticum: Gnaphalium sylvaticum is weedy perennial of north temperate regions having woolly foliage and dirty white flowers in a leafy spike.
Gnaphalium sylvaticum means the same as chafeweed or wood cudweed.
gnarl: A gnarl is something twisted and tight and swollen.
For example: "Their muscles stood out in knots."
Gnarl can also mean twist into a state of deformity.
Gnarl can also mean make complaining remarks or noises under one's breath.
Gnarl means the same as knot or murmur or mutter.
gnat: A gnat is any of various small biting flies: midges.
gnatcatcher: Gnatcatcher is very small North American and South American warblers.
gnathion: A gnathion is the most inferior point of the mandible in the midline.
gnathostomata: Gnathostomata is comprising all vertebrates with upper and lower jaws.
Gnathostomata means the same as superclass Gnathostomata.
gnathostome: A gnathostome is a vertebrate animal possessing true jaws.
gnawer: Gnawer is relatively small placental mammals having a single pair of constantly growing incisor teeth specialized for gnawing.
Gnawer means the same as rodent.
gnawing mammal: Gnawing mammal is relative large gnawing animals.
Gnawing mammal means the same as lagomorph.
gneiss: A gneiss is a laminated metamorphic rock similar to granite.
gnetaceae: Gnetaceae is plants having small unisexual flowers and fleshy or winged fruit: in some classifications includes the genera Ephedra and Welwitschia as well as genus Gnetum.
Gnetaceae means the same as family Gnetaceae.
gnetales: Gnetales is chiefly tropical or xerophytic woody plants.
Gnetales means the same as order Gnetales.
gnetophyta: Gnetophyta means the same as Gnetopsida or class Gnetopsida or Gnetophytina.
gnetophytina: Gnetophytina means the same as Gnetopsida or class Gnetopsida or subdivision Gnetophytina.
gnetopsida: Gnetopsida means the same as class Gnetopsida or Gnetophytina or subdivision Gnetophytina.
gnetum: Gnetum is small tropical tree with tiered branches and divaricate branchlets having broad glossy dark green leaves.
Gnetum means the same as Gnetum gnemon.
gnetum gnemon: Gnetum gnemon is small tropical tree with tiered branches and divaricate branchlets having broad glossy dark green leaves.
Gnetum gnemon means the same as gnetum.
gnocchi: Gnocchi is a small dumpling made of potato or flour or semolina that is boiled or baked and is usually served with a sauce or with grated cheese.
gnome: A gnome is a legendary creature resembling a tiny old man.
Gnome can also mean a short pithy saying expressing a general truth.
Gnome means the same as dwarf.
gnomon: Gnomon is indicator provided by the stationary arm whose shadow indicates the time on the sundial.
gnosis: Gnosis is intuitive knowledge of spiritual truths.
gnostic: Gnostic means of or relating to Gnosticism.
Gnostic can also mean an advocate of Gnosticism.
Gnostic can also mean possessing intellectual or esoteric knowledge of spiritual things.
gnosticism: Gnosticism is a religious orientation advocating gnosis as the way to release a person's spiritual element.
gnp: GNP is former measure of the United States economy.
GNP means the same as gross national product.
gnu: Gnu is large African antelope having a head with horns like an ox and a long tufted tail.
Gnu means the same as wildebeest.
gnu goat: Gnu goat is large heavily built goat antelope of eastern Himalayan area.
Gnu goat means the same as takin or Budorcas taxicolor.
gnash: To gnash means to grind together, of teeth.
gnaw: To gnaw means to bite or chew on with the teeth.
Gnaw can also mean become ground down or deteriorate.
Gnaw means the same as erode or gnaw at or eat at.
gnaw at: To gnaw at means to become ground down or deteriorate.
Gnaw at means the same as erode or gnaw or eat at.
gnarled: Gnarled means used of old persons or old trees.
Gnarled means the same as gnarly or knotted or knotty.
gnarly: Gnarly means used of old persons or old trees.
Gnarly means the same as gnarled or knotted or knotty.
gnomic: Gnomic means relating to or containing gnomes.
gnomish: Gnomish means used of small deformed creatures.
